title: A finite-presentation coefficient structure descends to a tensor stage
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $i_0\in I$. Let $B_0$ be a commutative $F(i_0)$-algebra, $B=A\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$, and $P$ a finitely presented $\mathbf Z$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Given a $P$-algebra structure on $B$, there are $i\ge i_0$ and a $P$-algebra structure on $B_i=F(i)\otimes_{F(i_0)}B_0$ such that the canonical ring map $\mu_i:B_i\to B$ is a $P$-algebra map.

proof.text: Define tensor transition maps on the upper tail of i₀. Tensor induction and functoriality prove composition and compatibility with the canonical maps to B. The elementwise base-change lemma supplies representatives and eventual vanishing.

proof.text: Choose a finite polynomial presentation π over Z with finite kernel generators. Lift each polynomial generator to a stage using representatives, then choose one upper bound for the finite list. Polynomial evaluation p at this stage agrees with algebraMap P B composed with π after mapping to B, by polynomial extensionality on constants and variables.

proof.text: Each kernel generator therefore evaluates to an element vanishing in B. Eventual vanishing gives a later stage for each, and a finite upper bound gives one stage killing all of them. Composition of tensor transitions shows the full kernel is killed. Descend the polynomial map along π using its surjectivity. The resulting P → Bᵢ equips Bᵢ with a real algebra structure; surjectivity of π proves that Bᵢ → B is P-linear.

theorem exists_tensor_algebra_structure_finite_stage
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) [CommRing B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀]
    (P : Type y) [CommRing P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)) :
    ∃ (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i),
    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
    let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
      { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
        commutes' := fun s ↦
          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
    ∃ (aPi : Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      ∃ (μB : (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
          (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        μB.toRingHom =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom
